title: InvestorInterestSignal
description: One structured investor-interest signal extracted from a single HubSpot engagement (call summary, email, meeting, note). Read-only derivation from HubSpot; no CRM writes. One record per engagement, keyed by signal_id.

hubspot_url.description: Deep link to the engagement in HubSpot for click-through.

contact.description: Best-effort contact context. IDs/emails require an association lookup; may be null when only the transcript name is known.

owner.description: Moonfare rep / relationship manager on the engagement (name or owner id).

sentiment_score.description: Optional numeric sentiment, -1 (very negative) to +1 (very positive).

asset_classes.description: Asset classes / strategies the investor showed interest in. Controlled vocab (taxonomy.json).

industries.description: Sector interests mentioned (e.g. Technology, Healthcare, AI, Energy). Free-text but kept short.

raw.description: As it appeared in the source (pre-normalization).

canonical.description: Canonical fund name, or null if unmatched.

competitors_mentioned.description: Rival platforms/managers the investor is comparing against (from funds.json competitors).

ticket_size.description: Investor's own stated/implied ticket. Null when none was expressed (e.g. only platform minimums were discussed).

amount_eur.description: Point estimate normalized to EUR, or null for a range/unknown.

next_step.description: Agreed follow-up / next action, if any.

next_step_date.description: Deadline or scheduled follow-up date if mentioned (ISO date).

quotes.description: Short supporting evidence paraphrased/quoted from the source.

summary.description: One-to-two sentence extraction summary of the investor signal.

source_excerpt.description: Trimmed plain-text of the source for traceability.
